name: Valheim
description: Vanilla Valheim dedicated server. The game port is UDP and is 2456 by convention; Valheim always answers server-browser queries on the game port + 1, so give the Query port that number. Worlds are saved in .config/unity3d/IronGate/Valheim. Valheim has no command console: type 'stop' to save the world and shut down.
startup_command: export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="./linux64:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}" SteamAppId=892970; ( while read -r cmd; do case "${cmd}" in stop|quit|exit|shutdown) echo "[Atlas] Saving the world and stopping Valheim..."; kill -INT "$(cat /tmp/valheim.pid)" ;; *) echo "[Atlas] Valheim has no command console. Type 'stop' to save the world and shut down." ;; esac; done ) <&0 & ( echo "${BASHPID}" > /tmp/valheim.pid; exec ./valheim_server.x86_64 -nographics -batchmode -name "${SERVER_NAME}" -port {{SERVER_PORT}} -world "${WORLD}" -password "${PASSWORD}" -public $( [[ "${PUBLIC_SERVER}" =~ ^(1|true)$ ]] && echo 1 || echo 0 ) -saveinterval {{SAVE_INTERVAL}} -backups {{BACKUP_COUNT}} $( [[ "${ENABLE_CROSSPLAY}" =~ ^(1|true)$ ]] && printf %s -crossplay ) ) | sed -uE '/^\(Filename:.*Line:[[:space:]]+[[:digit:]]+\)$/d; /^[[:space:]]*$/d'

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: World Name
variables.description: World to load; it is created when it does not exist yet. Changing it switches to another world and keeps the old one.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password players need to join. Valheim refuses to start with a password shorter than 5 characters or one that is part of the server name. Change the default.

variables.name: Public Server
variables.description: List the server in the community server browser. When off it can only be joined by address.

variables.name: Crossplay
variables.description: Let Xbox and Microsoft Store players join. Crossplay servers are joined with a join code printed in the console and relay traffic through PlayFab.

variables.name: Backups
variables.description: How many automatic world backups are kept.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Steam app id of the dedicated server. The installer and the update check on start both use it.

variables.name: Automatic Updates
variables.description: Check Steam for a game update every time the server starts.
